title: Playbook: Fix an edge mid-word / mid-phrase
text: The check lists it: ripple-extend to the next gap of >= 0.2 s between words; pull back instead when the added words would be a dangling opener (แล้ว, ก็, คือ); skip when the added source already plays elsewhere.
